# dLocal Docs Documentation

> dLocal Documentation helps you find all the information you need to start using dLocal products. Our payment platform empowers you to reach billions of customers, accept payments, send payouts, and settle funds globally.

## Guides
- [Enable Live mode](https://docs.dlocal.com/docs/enable-live-mode.md): Learn how to switch from sandbox to production and start processing real payments with dLocal.
- [Generate a signature](https://docs.dlocal.com/docs/generate-signature.md): Learn how to create a signature for your API requests. This is required for all requests to dLocal’s API.
- [Get your API credentials 🆕](https://docs.dlocal.com/docs/get-api-credentials-new.md): Learn how to generate, rotate, and delete API credentials to securely interact with dLocal API.
- [Get your API credentials](https://docs.dlocal.com/docs/get-api-credentials.md): Learn everything you need to know about your dLocal API credentials.
- [Get started](https://docs.dlocal.com/docs/get-started.md): Find all the information you need to start using dLocal products.
- [Configure initial settings](https://docs.dlocal.com/docs/initial-settings.md): Learn how to configure the initial settings in order to access the production platform.
- [Make a test payment](https://docs.dlocal.com/docs/make-a-test-payment.md): Learn how to simulate payments using dLocal’s sandbox environment before going live.
- [PCI Compliance](https://docs.dlocal.com/docs/pci-compliance.md): Learn about dLocal's PCI DSS compliance standards and requirements for secure payment processing.
- [Using LLMs with dLocal](https://docs.dlocal.com/docs/using-llms.md): Boost your dLocal integration workflow with LLMs.

- [Handle accounts](https://docs.dlocal.com/docs/handle-accounts-platforms.md): Learn account management essentials.

## API Reference
- [API Reference](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/api.md)
- [Postman API Collection](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/postman-api-collection.md): Learn how to create and manage online payments using the Postman collection to make requests to the dLocal API.
- [General integration issues](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/troubleshooting-integration.md): Learn how to quickly troubleshoot common integration issues.
- [Signature creation](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/troubleshooting-signature.md): Learn how to quickly troubleshoot common signature creation issues.
- [Document information](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/document-information.md): Find out which documents are required for successful KYC process.
- [Get documents](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/get-verification-documents-1.md): Returns the documentation required for the verification. Requirements may differ per verification.  The service may return **more than one list item with the same document `name`** (e.g. multiple `SOURCE_OF_FUNDS_DECLARATION` entries). Each entry has its own `id` and `status`; all required items must be completed and approved as applicable.  Documents must be submitted and validated by dLocal before the verification can be approved and related holds (e.g. payouts) released.
- [Update document](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/update-verification-document-1.md): Updates a specific document using `multipart/form-data`.  **Allowed only when document `status` is `PENDING`.** After `COMPLETED`, `ERROR`, or `APPROVED`, PATCH updates are rejected.
- [Environment](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/environment-verifications.md): Learn more about the different environments available.
- [Update verification state (sandbox only)](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/update-verification-state-1.md): **Sandbox only.** Changes verification status while preserving realistic flow transitions, so you can simulate states and receive notifications.  Official reference uses host `sandbox.dlocal.com` and path `/kyc/sanbox-tools/verifications/{verification-id}` (note **sanbox** spelling in the path).
- [Create a verification](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/create-verification-1.md): Creates a verification. Available and mandatory fields depend on the type of client, country, and industry. The service returns a **verification ID** for use with Payins and Payouts APIs.  **Wire format:** the endpoint accepts `multipart/form-data` with a string field `body` whose value is a JSON string with the **same** structure as the `application/json` body below, and optional `file` parts (use filenames such as `DOCUMENT_FRONT` and `DOCUMENT_BACK` where required). The JSON body below is the reference shape; stringify it to populate the `body` part when using multipart.  **Notifications:** status updates will be sent to the `notification_url` provided in the request. See the **Callbacks** section below and the [Verifications notifications](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/verifications-notifications) guide for the retries policy and signature recipe.
- [Get verification details](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/get-verification-1.md): Returns verification details for any verification type. Use query parameter `include=client_data` for extended client information.  Notifications about status changes are sent to the `notification_url` from the create request. Contact your Technical Account Manager for notification setup assistance.
- [Verification status](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/verification-status.md): Understand the verification status descriptions to know its condition.
- [Verification types](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/verification-types.md): Explore Payout on Hold and Remittance verification types.
- [Verifications notifications](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/verifications-notifications.md): Notifications will be sent when the status of a verification changes.
- [Cancel an authorization](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/cancel-an-authorization.md): This service allows you to cancel an authorized transaction before it's captured.
- [Capture an authorization](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/capture-authorization.md): Learn how to capture authorized amounts and complete transactions.
- [Create an authorization](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/create-authorization.md): Learn how to check if a card is valid and has enough funds available.
- [Chargeback asynchronous notification](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/chargeback-asynchronous-notification.md): If a chargeback was applied (requested by the user) a notification is sent to the previously registered Merchant chargeback notification URL.
- [Chargeback status](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/chargeback-status.md)
- [Retrieve a chargeback status](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/retrieve-a-chargeback-status.md)
- [Retrieve a chargeback](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/retrieve-a-chargeback.md): Retrieve information about a chargeback.
- [Simulate chargeback (Sandbox only)](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/simulate-chargeback-sandbox-only.md): Simulate a chargeback in sandbox.
- [Country Reference](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/country-reference.md): Learn all about the countries currently covered by dLocal.
- [Get an exchange rate](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/get-an-exchange-rate.md): Get the exchange rate between two currencies.
- [Cancel an enrollment](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/cancel-an-enrollment.md): Cancels an active enrollment. Once cancelled, no further recurring payments can be initiated against this enrollment.
- [Create enrollment](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/create-enrollment.md): Creates a new enrollment to enable recurring payments for a payer. Use this endpoint for enrollments **without** an initial payment.  > **Enrollment with an initial payment:** Use `POST /payments` and include an `enrollment` object in the request body.  **Enrollment types:** - `ON_DEMAND`: Merchant initiates recurring payments at any time, with no frequency or amount restrictions. - `MERCHANT_SUBSCRIPTION`: Merchant initiates recurring payments based on defined subscription settings (frequency, amount, dates).
- [Enrollment status codes](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/enrollment-status-codes.md)
- [Get enrollment](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/get-enrollment.md): Retrieve information about an existing enrollment by its dLocal enrollment ID.
- [Create an installments plan](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/create-an-installments-plan.md): This service allows you to create customized installment plans for card payments.
- [The 3D-Secure Object](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/3d-secure-object.md): Detailed reference for the 3D-Secure object structure and implementation requirements.
- [The Payment Method Object](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/payment-method-object.md): Object that identifies each payment method accepted by dLocal.
- [The Address Object](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/the-address-object.md): Detailed reference for the Address object structure and formatting requirements.
- [The Bank Transfer Object](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/the-bank-transfer-object.md): Detailed reference for the Bank Transfer object structure used in bank transfer payments.
- [The Card Object](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/the-card-object.md): Detailed reference for the Card object structure and required fields for payment processing.
- [The Currency Exchange Object](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/the-currency-exchange-object.md): Detailed reference for the Currency Exchange object used in multi-currency transactions.
- [The DeviceId Object (for Mercado Pago only)](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/the-deviceid-object-for-mercado-pago-only.md): Detailed reference for implementing and using the DeviceId object in Mercado Pago integrations.
- [The Installment Object](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/the-installment-object.md): Detailed reference for the Installment object properties and how to use them in payment plans.
- [The Installment Plan Object](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/the-installment-plan-object.md): Detailed reference for the Installment object used in installment plan creation.
- [The Order Object](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/the-order-object.md): Detailed reference for the Order object structure and how it's used in payment processing.
- [The Payer Object](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/the-payer-object.md): Detailed reference for the Payer object structure and required fields in API requests.
- [The Refund Object](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/the-refund-object.md): Detailed reference for the Refund object structure and properties used in refund operations.
- [The Ticket Object](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/the-ticket-object.md): Detailed reference for the Ticket object used in cash payment methods.
- [The Wallet Object](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/the-wallet-object.md): The Wallet object represents a digital wallet payment method used to process one-time or recurring payments.
- [Retrieve an Order](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/retrieve-an-order.md): Retrieve information about an existing order.
- [Security](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/payins-security.md): Learn how to set up the headers for making API requests, and encrypt sensitive information.
- [Search payment methods](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/search-payment-methods.md): This function returns a list of valid payment methods for the requested country.
- [Cancel pending payment](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/cancel-alternative-payment.md): Cancel pending payments for alternative payment methods (APMs).
- [Cancel wallet token](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/cancel-wallet-token.md): This service allows merchants to cancel an active token.
- [Create payment](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/create-payment.md): Creates a new payment using any of the available payment methods.
- [Payments HTTP Errors](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/http-errors-payments.md): Detailed reference for HTTP error responses in dLocal payment API.
- [Payment status codes](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/payment-status-codes.md): Use payment status codes for in-depth situation analysis.
- [Get payment status](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/retrieve-a-payment-status.md): Retrieve information about the status of an existing payment.
- [Get payment](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/retrieve-a-payment.md): Retrieve information about an existing payment.
- [Refunds HTTP Errors](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/http-errors-refunds.md)
- [Make a refund](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/make-a-refund.md): This service allows you to create and read refunds of an existing payment.
- [Refund codes](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/refund-status-codes.md)
- [Check refund status](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/retrieve-a-refund-status.md): Retrieve information about the status of a refund.
- [Retrieve a refund](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/retrieve-a-refund.md): Retrieve information about a refund.
- [Retrieve an order](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/retrieve-order-refund.md): Retrieve information about an existing refund order.
- [Create a card](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/create-a-card.md): Securely register a card with dLocal and receive a `card_id` to use for future payments.
- [Delete a card](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/delete-a-card.md): Unlink a `card_id` so that it cannot be used any further.
- [Saving cards HTTP Errors](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/http-errors-cards.md): Detailed reference for HTTP error responses when working with saved cards in dLocal.
- [Retrieve a card](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/retrieve-a-card.md): Retrieve information about a saved card.
- [Create unique reference](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/virtual-account.md): This service generates unique references for virtual account payments.
- [Errors](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/account-validation-errors.md): Detailed reference for error codes and messages when validating payment accounts.
- [Account validation](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/account-validation.md): Learn how to validate bank accounts and payment methods before processing transactions.
- [Create a quote](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/create-quote-payouts-v3.md): This endpoint generates an FX rate for a particular currency pair.
- [Environments](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/environments-payouts-v3.md): Learn more about the different environments available.
- [Error codes](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/error-codes-payouts-v3.md): The error code and HTTP status shown when a payout fails.
- [Cancel payout](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/cancel-payout-v3.md): This endpoint allows you to cancel a payout.
- [Get balance](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/get-balance-payouts-v3.md): This service allows you to check your available balance for making payouts.
- [Get payout](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/get-payout-v3.md): This service brings the payout information based on the payout ID or the external ID.
- [Release payout](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/release-payout-v3.md): Release `On hold` payouts.
- [Submit a payout](https://docs.dlocal.com/reference/requesting-payout-v3.md): Learn how to start making payouts.
